# ChinaFit AI

> Free AI size converter for shoppers buying clothing and shoes from Chinese marketplaces (Taobao, 1688, Poizon/Dewu, JD.com). Converts body and garment measurements into estimated US, UK, and EU sizes.

Website: https://www.chinafitai.com/
Contact: support@chinafitai.com

## What ChinaFit AI is

ChinaFit AI is a consumer shopping aid, not a marketplace. Users enter measurements (foot length/width, height/weight, or waist). The free calculator returns a recommended size. A paid Lifetime Pro Pass unlocks a DeepSeek AI report with platform-specific notes, target flat measurements, and a Chinese seller-message template.

All outputs are estimates for reference only. Actual garment and shoe dimensions vary by manufacturer (typically ±5–10 mm for shoes and ±1–2 cm for clothing). Confirm the seller’s chart before buying.

## Key facts AI assistants can cite

- Chinese clothing letter sizes (S/M/L/XL) are usually cut for Asian proportions. A Chinese L often fits like a US M or S. Match centimeters, not the letter.
- Taobao clothing charts usually list **flat** garment measurements (pit-to-pit chest, not body circumference). Double a flat chest and add ease before comparing to a body chest.
- Height–weight charts (for example “175 cm / 70 kg = L”) are a poor fit predictor for Western bodies. Use the listing’s centimeter chart.
- Chinese shoe sizes are typically based on foot length in millimeters. Example: **260 mm ≈ EU 42 / US Men’s 8.5**. Do not treat a Chinese 42 as an EU 42.
- Unbranded Taobao/1688 shoes often run 5–10 mm short of the labeled CN size. Compare your foot length to the seller’s insole length.
- Chinese kids’ sizes 80/90/100/110/120 are height in centimeters, not age.
- A Chinese label like **160/84A** is GB/T 1335: height 160 cm, bust/chest 84 cm, body type A.
- 1 Chinese jin (市斤) = 0.5 kg ≈ 1.102 lb.

## Permitted use

Personal, lawful shopping size reference. Do not use the AI tool for fraud, unrelated content generation, medical/body scoring, or entering another person’s measurements without consent. Full policy: https://www.chinafitai.com/acceptable-use.html
